programme.title: Forensic Files: Nursery Crimes
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lasting Impression
programme.desc: When the decomposed body of a teenage girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity. To solve the case, investigators turn to bug larvae found on the body and a tiny wad of chewing gum found near the victim's body.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Foundation of Lies
programme.desc: Police suspect Dr. John "Jack" Boyle in the disappearance of his wife, Noreen, when he signs mortgage papers for a new house with a woman pretending to be his spouse. The police later find Noreen's body in the basement of Dr. Boyle's new house.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Vows
programme.desc: Survivors of Nazi atrocities recognized Archbishop Trifa, former head of the Romanian Orthodox Church in America, as having directed a bloody attack against Jews during World War II. He was deported in 1984 and died three years later.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Time Will Tell
programme.desc: In this international case of extortion, murder and stolen identities, scam-artist Albert J. Walker assumes the identity of co-worker Ronald Platt. Platt later turns up dead in an ocean with an anchor tied around his torso.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Second Shot at Love
programme.desc: When heart surgeon Darryl Sutorius is found dead in the basement of his upscale Cincinnati home, police assume he committed suicide. Further investigation reveals that his new wife Della has a history of violence and an insatiable desire for money.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Journey to Justice
programme.desc: 6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft. Lauderdale neighborhood. The prosecutor combines the talents of an accident reconstruction expert with a video specialist to create a graphic demonstration of the moment of impact.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Video Diary
programme.desc: When convenience store employee Wanda Mason is found dead, investigators find the entire murder has been caught on the store's security camera. But the image of the killer is so degraded it seems impossible to positively identify him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis: We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder?

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Natural Witness
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Have Two Husbands
programme.desc: Jessica married Gian after a five-month relationship. With a baby on the way, everything seems to be going great for the couple, except Jessica is married to another man, Michael!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: An Explosive DNA Story
programme.desc: Teneal and Richard are telling different tales, each alleging the other is unfit to parent! The truth will come down to a lie detector test, and the results will be shocking!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Can't Face The Truth.
programme.desc: Today Danny is finally ready to face the missing man in his life and get answers to lifelong questions. Steven offers a number of excuses for not seeing his son, but can he redeem himself?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
programme.desc: Two years ago, Latisha and her boyfriend were found shot to death in their car. Latisha’s mother Nancy believes her ex-husband Kenneth was involved. Who is responsible for their deaths?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, Get Him Out!
programme.desc: Kelly’s ex-husband Nikki continues to haunt her. He went to jail for killing her 2 week old son and is now dating her 18 year old daughter! Can Steve get Nikki out of their lives forever?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Lockdown
programme.desc: When a crazed gunman terrorizes his neighborhood, officers put themselves in the line of fire to restore order.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: George Ferribee, a loving son led astray by addiction, is found executed. When Lt. Joe Kenda learns the victim had recently been kidnapped, he assumes the crimes are related.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Chance Encounter
programme.desc: When firefighters find Victor Woods stabbed to death in his burning apartment, homicide detective Joe Kenda tracks Colorado's most notorious serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder in a Bottle
programme.desc: Eric Houston is found stabbed to death in a seedy motel, but the ensuing investigation is stymied by a long list of suspects. Lt. Joe Kenda deploys a groundbreaking new technology to catch the killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Emma Golightly – Lonely Hearts Con Woman

programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.

programme.desc: 1945 frigjør soldater fra den Røde Hæren Auschwitz-Birkenau. Når andre befrielsene finner sted i de påfølgende månedene, blir verden sjokkert.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution: Suprising Beginnings
programme.desc: Tyske kommandører oppdager effektiviteten i å gasse fanger, og Auschwitz forvandles fra en liten bakgårdsleir for de som motarbeider den nazistiske okkupasjonen av Polen, til en storstilt utryddelsesleir for jøder.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil ha tilbake nettsiden min
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie taper sin iCarly URL til Nevel, krever han at Carly skal kysse ham hvis hun vil ha tilbake deres URL. Imens har Spencer det moro med de tohundre putene som han feilaktig har bestilt.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239
programme.desc: Når Sam og Freddie begge to vinner konkurransen for skolens beste skap, slir de nødt til å dele skap. Carly ber Spencer gi henne timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly utdelingen
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie holder en iCarly-galla for de beste bruker-bidragene i iCarly, og hyller pristagerne live på web-showet. Spencer verver europeiske badedraktmodeller for å hjelpe ham å lage premiestatuettene.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver å bevise at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forkledning. Når Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer å overbevise henne om at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 2
programme.desc: Når Carly oppdager at hennes tøffe kjæreste Griffin samler på små Pee Wee Babies, må hun ta stilling til om hun holder ut å date en kar som har en kosedyrsamling. I mens forsøker Spencer å hjelpe Sam med å bli kvitt et mareritt.

programme.title: iCarly: iKamp mot Dingo
programme.desc: Dingo-kanalen har stjålet idéer fra iCarly, så Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer drar til Dingos Studio for å fortelle manusforfatterne hva de mener om det.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg tror de kysset
programme.desc: Da Sam kommer til å avsløre overfor Carly at hun og Freddie smugkysset, konfronterer Carly dem med hvorfor de ikke fortalte henne om det. Og Spencer underviser fanger i billedkunst i fengselet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokkekamp
programme.desc: Når Carl, Sam og Freddie vinner over en berømt tv-kokk i en matlagningskonkurranse, vil ikke kokken lage mat mer og nekter å komme ut av soverommet sitt. Spencer prøver å oppfylle en fremtidsdrøm.

programme.title: iCarly: Rektor kampen
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie får rektor Franklin sparket, overtar miss Briggs og mr. Howard ledelsen og innfører strenge regler. Og Spencer leier en gammel rodeostjerne til å lære ham å ri på en mekanisk okse.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og en serie avsløringer gjør både Jenna og Jake sønderknuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å rydde opp i kjærlighetslivet sitt da en uventet tekstmelding retter søkelyset mot alle problemene hennes.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Etter at bloggen hennes ble lansert, mener alle noe om Jennas privatliv. Men mens andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, vil Jake og Matty ha svar.

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jenna lar fantasien løpe løpsk på bloggen. Ved å undersøke og dikte opp en annen versjon av fortiden prøver hun å forutse fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om guttene blir offentlig og når hun også får reise til Europa ser alt ut til å gå hennes vei. Men det skjer noe som får Jenna til å tvile på om det alltid er så lurt å få alt man ønsker seg.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: I løpet av junioråret opplever Jenna en bølge av overraskelser og forandringer som kan komme til å få følger for fremtiden hennes.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekamerat dør, og Jenna tenker over det inntrufne, sørger og tar ansvar for noe hun har holdt hemmelig for Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty blir fjern når han finner ut om Jennas mulige graviditet, og Jenna er villig til nesten hva som helst for å slippe å prate om det.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far tar saken i egne hender for å få snakke med Mattys foreldre om deres barns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Når Matty flytter inn hos Hamiltonfamilien, oppdager Jenna at samboerskap er mer enn det hun hadde regent med.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøkelsene fra Jennas fortid kommer fram igjen, og det gjør også hennes usikkerhet - akkurat i tide til Halloweenfeiringen i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This episode of Unplugged features Canadian star Alanis Morissette, shot from the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Mando Diao MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Med gjesteartister som Ane Brun, Kristofer Greczula og Veera Pyykkö inntar Mando Diao MTV Unplugged-scenen. Pluto TV byr på en nedstrippet og intim konsert med Mando Diao fra deres nye album «Efter Solnedgången».

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Lenny Kravitz unplugged.

programme.title: Patrice O'Neal: Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: På brutalt morsomt vis avslører Patrice O'Neal de uuttalte sannhetene om verdien av hvite kvinner, juks, trygg sex og behovet for en offisiell trakasseringsdag i sin ståopp-spesial, filmet i New York City.

programme.title: Christopher Titus: The 5th Annual End Of The World Tour
programme.desc: Ifølge Titus er omtrent alt et tegn på verre ting på horisonten. Prins Charles ser ut til å ha giftet seg med Mick Jagger, mennesker må gjenerobre månen, og dyreriket er så forbannet at det fins gale kuer som vil ta folk.

programme.title: Review: Curing Homosexuality / Mile High Club
programme.desc: Forrest forsøker å få en ung homofil mann hetero og oppdager at å ha sex på et fly er overraskende vanskelig.

programme.title: Review: Falsely Accused / Sleep with Your Teacher / Little Person
programme.desc: Forrest lar Josh felle ham for en forbrytelse, har sex med en high school-lærer og opplever det daglige slitet med å være en liten person.

programme.title: Review: Cult / Perfect Body
programme.desc: Forrest samler følgere til sin nye kult og og begynner et kroppsforbedringsregime i jakten på det perfekte.

programme.title: Another Period: Roosevelt
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer familien Roosevelt til Bellacourt Manor for å overbevise Teddy om å velge Frederick som visepresident. Lillian kaster blikket på FDR, Beatrice får en forbindelse med Eleanor. Peepers basker med en tjenerstreik.

programme.title: Another Period: Servant's Disease
programme.desc: En smittsom sykdom sprer seg nedunder og Lillian ender i karantene med de syke tjenerne. Beatrice og Frederick går på en dobbeldate og Victor og Albert kommer opp i krangel om sin barbershop-kvartett.

programme.title: Another Period: Harvard
programme.desc: Albert Einstein besøker Bellacourt Manor og Beatrice hjelper ham å løse hans komplekse formel. Lillian prøver å framskaffe et kondom for å ha sex for nytelsens skyld og Peepers graver fram Blanches 'kjæreste' fra galehuset.

programme.title: Another Period: Joplin
programme.desc: Lillian og Beatrice prøver å skrive en slager ved hjelp av en Kanye-esque komponist ved navn Joplin. Peepers basker vilt med sine nyoppdagede og kjødelige begjær.

programme.title: Corporate: Corporate Retreat

programme.title: School of Rock: Forandringer
programme.desc: Fru Calpakis kommer tilbake på jobb, og Dewey er plutselig overflødig, til klassens store fortvilelse. Han får en ny vikarjobb på skolen, som lærer for en førskoleklasse, og verken han eller den gamle klassen hans er særlig fornøyd.

programme.title: School of Rock: Det Hadde Vel Vært Fint?
programme.desc: Dewey sprenger skapet til Freddy ved et uhell, og det er starten på en lang rekke forviklinger som handler om hvem som skal dele skap med hvem.

programme.title: School of Rock: Med eller Uten Deg
programme.desc: Lawrence bygger et fantastisk lydstudio, men blir fort både kjepphøy og vanskelig å forholde seg til for de andre i bandet. Samtidig sliter Summer med å komme inn i et fantastisk fantasy-univers som alle vennene hennes er hekta på.

programme.title: School of Rock: Strålende Forkledning
programme.desc: Det er tid for skoledans, og bandet vil prøve å få spille på dansen uten at noen avslører hvem de er. Men Clark er mistenksom og gjør det ikke lett for dem. Samtidig blir Summer sjalu og lei seg når Kale åpenlyst flørter med Freddy.

programme.title: School of Rock: Lønnsomme Forretninger
programme.desc: Dewey underviser elevene om økonomi, og Zac ser straks en forretningsidé i Lawrences oppfinnelser. Samtidig sliter Dewey med å pugge til lærereksamen, men Tomika og Summer tror de skal klare å lære han det som skal til for å klare prøven.

programme.title: School of Rock: Skal Hun Virkelig Gå Ut med Ham?
programme.desc: Summer blir bare mer og mer sjalu på Kale, og legger en plan for å ødelegge forholdet mellom Kale og Freddy. Zack og Lawrence blir redde når de får inntrykk av at rektor er forelsket i en av dem.

programme.title: School of Rock: Stemmer Bærer
programme.desc: Clark tvinger Freddy til å bli med i vokalgruppen sin, men blir sur når han oppdager at Freddy er flinkere til å synge enn han selv er.

programme.title: School of Rock: Jeg Forhekser Deg
programme.desc: Dewey laster ned en hypnose-app, og Summer blir glad når han fikser sangstemmen hennes så hun kan delta i en talentkonkurranse. Dessverre hynpotiserer han også rektor Mullins, noe gutta vet å utnytte.

programme.title: School of Rock: Matkrig
programme.desc: Skolekantinen blir stengt når det blir oppdatet en rotte der, og Zack griper anledningen til å begynne å selge sine spesiallagede matshakes fra en bil på parkeringsplassen. Dessverre får han snart konkurranse fra sin erkefiende Justin.

programme.title: School of Rock: Velkommen til Marerittet
programme.desc: Dewey gleder seg til å feire halloween og blir veldig skuffet når klassen forteller at sånt er strengt forbudt på skolen deres. Dewey mener at de skal kjempe for retten til å feire. Og så blir rektor Mullins syk.

programme.title: School of Rock: Total Formørkelse i Hjertet
programme.desc: Alle elevene skal overnatte på skolen. Tomika prøver å vri seg unna, for hun er redd for å sove andre steder enn hjemme, men Dewey lover å hjelpe henne. Lawrence og Zack leter etter det mystiske puddingrommet.
